load_scale_dict_from_json: load scale factors from a JSON file mapping scale factor names to values
load_scale_dict_from_pt: load scale factors from a pickled torch .pt file mapping names to values
load_scales_into_module: load scale factors from a file or dict into a PyTorch module with ScaleFactor submodules
review_load_scales_compat: review the load_scales_compat function that applies scale factors to a PyTorch module
refactor_load_scale_dict: refactor the _load_scale_dict function to support additional file formats beyond JSON and PT
